newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Western Resources estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Western Resources estimates raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it raised its estimates for Western Resources Inc's fiscal 1997 and fiscal 1998 earnings in the wake of its business combination with Oneok Inc.
-- EVEREN raised its fiscal 1997 estimate to $2.85 from $2.80, while its fiscal 1998 estimate was raised to $3.00 from $2.90.

-- EVEREN said Western Resources will gain access to Oneok's 735,000 gas customers, which could become potential electric customers. Oneok and Western Resources agreed to combine their natural gas assets.

-- Western is not expected to realize the full earnings effect from the deal until fiscal 1998, EVEREN said, because potential revenue enhancements through retail energy marketing nationwide will not yet be available.
-- Western Resources is an electric power generator and distributor.
-- The company's stock was up 1/4 Friday at 30-7/8.
